title: Water in Fuel Sensor High Error
detail_of_failure: A high voltage occurs in the signal circuit of the water sensor of the fuel prefilter.
machine_effect: The water separator monitor does not operate normally.
related_information: • The signal state (ON/OFF) of the water sensor in the fuel prefilter can be checked with monitoring function. (Code: 18800) • After the repair is done, check that the failure code is not shown with the operation that follows. Procedure: Turn the starting switch to the ON position.

steps.procedure: Check the wiring harness and connector. For details, see “Related Information to Troubleshooting”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”.
1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector P47. Connect a T-adapter to the female side. REMARK If water is accumulated in the fuel prefilter, remove the water accumulated.

steps.cause: Open or short circuit in wiring harness
steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector ECM. Connect a T-adapter to the female side.

steps.cause: Open circuit in wiring harness (wire breakage or defective contact of connector)
steps.procedure: If no failure is found by check on cause 3, this check is not required. 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connectors ECM and P47. Connect a T-adapter to each female side.
1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connectors ECM and P47. Connect a T-adapter to the female side of ECM. Do the check with the multimeter in the continuity mode.

measurements.point: Between ECM (female) (14) and each pin other than pin (14)

steps.procedure: If no failure is found by the previous checks, engine controller is defective. (Because this is an internal defect, troubleshooting cannot be done.)
